{{Top|leg}}
A '''subsonic field emitter''' was a device that emitted a subsonic pulse attuned to the [[nervous system]]s of [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] insects and other vermin, discouraging them from entering within a six-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] radius of the signal.
